newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ sees Ansett earnings-positive in 12 months.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ sees Ansett earnings-positive in 12 months.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd Managing Director Jim McCrea said on Tuesday he expects the purchase of half of Australia's Ansett from TNT Ltd to be earnings positive in 12 months' time.
Air NZ said on Monday it expected the purchase to be neutral in the first 12 months.

McCrea told a news conference on Tuesday that Air NZ had pre-emptive rights over News Corp's 50 percent stake in Ansett, as was normal in such transactions. He declined to provide any further details.
McCrea, asked when he expected the purchase to be earnings positive, said: "Within the next 12 months."
He added: "There is a lot of work going on inside Ansett and a lot going on inside Air New Zealand, but all of these things take a little bit of work to bring together."
Air NZ announced terms late on Monday to buy TNT's half share in Ansett for a total investment of A$475 million.
